/works/echowear.description: EchoWear case study by Karthikeya Mantha. Sustainable wearable technology brand.
p: EchoWear is a fashion-forward ecommerce brand specializing in sustainable wearable technology. They needed a strong brand identity that reflected innovation, sustainability, and style. The challenge was to create a branding system that resonates with eco-conscious consumers while maintaining a sleek, modern appeal.

The branding solution focused on a minimal yet bold aesthetic, with a distinctive logo, refined typography, and an earthy color palette. /works/neurosync.description: NeuroSync case study by Karthikeya Mantha. Healthcare mobile app tracking neurological health.
p: NeuroSync is a healthcare mobile app that helps individuals monitor and manage neurological health. The challenge was to design an interface that simplifies complex medical data while ensuring accessibility for all users, including patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

The solution focused on a patient-centered design approach, featuring clear data visualizations, symptom tracking, and AI-driven insights. By prioritizing accessibility, the app integrates intuitive navigation, large touchpoints, and a calming color scheme to enhance the user experience. NeuroSync empowers users with real-time health insights, bridging the gap between patients and medical professionals.
